CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to the identified content.

COD.rationale: Identified content (red at p0/current/n0), an organization/access origin field, and a separate status-like origin are all present and bound to the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No attention/allocation or content-processing condition is explicitly linked to the content's presentation/access.

C.rationale: The report explicitly identifies content (red) and its coordinate for a named referent.

D.rationale: The report separately lists an identified content attribute (red) and an origin/status field for the same referent/time.

O.rationale: An origin/representation field describes how the content for the referent is organized/accessed (copied_prior_record).
